item.title: Tandem 1.0.6
item.description: Setup ends with a starting plan. Limit presets on the Limits step. A Fund your accounts guide. Viewing: Practice | Real. One-line Desk health.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.5
item.description: - Every page lists only the accounts you connected. - When an order is held or refused, the desk says why in a plain sentence. - If the Mac was asleep at 4:15 pm, the daily account record is taken when it wakes, marked as late. - If the desk stops while Tandem is open, the menu bar says Desk stopped and offers Restart desk. - If Tandem cannot copy your data before an update, it does not start and says what to do. Nothing is changed. - A Webull account connected for practice shows Done (paper) in setup while live waits for Webull's approval. - Routines show plain names, and the monthly venue checks say they are checked daily and run once a month. - The guides match the app, and a new Remove Tandem guide is in Help. - Phone alerts use the help contact as their sender contact. - The app is smaller: research parts you never use are no longer included.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.4
item.description: - Settings is one page with one menu on the left. - Adding an account starts with four venue cards; you choose practice or real in the same steps. - A short terms screen shows once. After that, one slim line reminds you until you accept. - Presets open as a catalog of cards. - The AI assistant page is the chat, with the account chosen next to the message box. - Webull crypto is found on your saved Webull connection. - Your return no longer goes blank after the Mac was off for a few days. It counts across the gap and says how many days were not recorded. - A monthly statement starts at the last close before the 1st of its month. - The tax export lists crypto as crypto, keeps its decimals, and does not run the wash-sale estimate on it. - Settings, About lists one notice for the dashboard's open-source libraries and says where the Python licences are.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.3
item.description: Practice | Real switch at the top. Real money can be turned on any time with Review, then Confirm. Daily database backup on this Mac. Start at login for new installs. Fixes: Polymarket US account drawer, slow start, red zero, Check for Updates in the menu bar icon.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.2
item.description: Faster pages; a fresh install sets itself up; Kalshi practice orders work; prices for Kalshi and crypto; 8-K filing alerts; wash-sale estimates and a tax-loss list; licences in About.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.1
item.description: Closing the window keeps Tandem running in the menu bar, with no Dock icon. You choose whether this Mac stays awake while the desk runs (Settings, This Mac). With it off, the Mac sleeps as usual and the desk checks your accounts again when it wakes. Quit Tandem from the menu bar and it stays off until you open it again.

item.title: Tandem 1.0.0
item.description: First release of Tandem. Drag it to Applications to install. Phone alerts set up with a QR code, an optional AI app, Remove Tandem in Settings, What's new after each update, and automatic updates from now on.
